name: TOB Sunday School Memory Verse
description: This week's assigned memory verse. reference is a plain "Book Chapter:Verse" string (e.g. "Psalm 23:1") — the Flutter app renders it with the already-built VerseRefTapText/openVersePopup so a student can read the actual verse in place instead of just seeing a citation. verse_text is deliberately NOT stored/cached here; it's always resolved live from the app's own Bible database.

fields.label: Course
fields.description: Which memorization curriculum/course this verse belongs to (e.g. "New Believer Course", "Psalms Course") — free text, drives the per-student, per-course verse mastery report.

fields.label: Verse Reference
fields.description: e.g. "Psalm 23:1" — must parse as "Book Chapter:Verse" (see verse_ref_popup.dart's parseVerseReference on the Flutter side).

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Published verses are ever returned to the app.
